description: Make a short video from attached pictures of people, objects and places, shown on a reference sheet first.

offer.reason: offered only when pictures are attached (or the chat already has a video made from pictures) and the person asks for a video; adult on their own written screen with video on

author: MaiPai

examples: Make a video of the girl in the red jacket in front of this building using my pictures
Use these pictures to make a short video where the dog plays in a pile of these cards
Make a short clip with the person in the first picture standing in the second picture's room
Put the man from this photo and this red car into a video driving through the place in the third picture
Same sheet, but make her walk away
Use the same reference sheet and make the car drive off instead

request.description: What should happen in the video, in the person's own words. Keep their meaning and details. Never list the attached pictures or their file names: Home reads each picture itself.

seconds.description: Optional length in seconds, 4 to 8. Leave out unless the person asks; the default is 8.

reuse_video.description: The id of an earlier video made from pictures in this chat, to make a new video from the SAME reference sheet without new pictures (for example 'same sheet, but make her walk away'). Use with request. Use 'latest' for the newest one.
